component.name: Nocturne
component.summary: Download audio from YouTube links and play everything offline
Descarcă audio din linkuri YouTube și redă totul offline
Скачивает звук по ссылкам YouTube и играет всё офлайн

description.p: Nocturne is a local music player. Paste a YouTube video or playlist link, Nocturne downloads the best audio stream and keeps everything in your Music folder for offline playback.

ul.li: Parallel downloads with progress and retries
Queue, shuffle, repeat, favorites and playlists
Media keys and desktop media widgets (MPRIS)
